cypher: MATCH (r:DLRepository)-[:DL_CONTAINS_FILE]->(f:DLFile) WHERE r.dataset=$dataset AND r.repo=$repo AND f.path STARTS WITH $prefix AND (f.path ENDS WITH '.md' OR f.path ENDS WITH '.rst' OR f.path ENDS WITH '.adoc') RETURN f.path AS entity,f.path AS fact,[r.id,f.id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY entity LIMIT 10
